## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`pnpm commit`)
- [ ] `pnpm check:quick` passes locally (or `pnpm check:ci` for larger changes)
- [ ] Tests updated when behavior changes
- [ ] No secrets, keystores, `.p8`, `.cer`, or real `.env` files included
- [ ] Product UI strings use i18n (no hardcoded user-facing copy)
- [ ] I did not hand-edit generated content under `apps/app/assets/data/` or generated shared content
- [ ] LICENSE / NOTICE / Required Notice lines left intact
- [ ] No sponsorship / funding / donation solicitations added
